$description: Layer 2 - semantic tokens. Every token names a role, never an appearance. text.muted survives a rebrand; text.grey500 does not. This is the only token layer product code and generated code may reference.

subtle.$description: Decorative only - dividers, table rules. Not held to 3:1 by design.

strong.$description: Boundary of an interactive control. Held to 3:1.

hairline.$description: Added in 4.2. The edge of a container that has no border - a row divider inside a card, a line under glass chrome. Decorative only, like border.subtle, and fainter by design.

control.$description: Minimum height of an interactive control. md is the default; sm is for toolbars, lg for touch.

indicator.$description: Added in 4.0. The drawn box or dot of a checkbox, radio or switch - the part the real input is visually replaced by. It was a 16px literal in three stylesheets, and its absence meant every value derived from it (a hint indent, a label offset) had to be precomputed by hand.

track.$description: Added in 4.0. The switch track. A control dimension rather than a padding role, which is why it is here and not in padding.* where the drift report's 48px suggested putting it.

textSize.$description: Type sizes by role. A component switches density by role, never by px.

textWeight.$description: Added in 4.0. Previously font-weight was a literal in 40 places, four of them off-scale.

fontFamily.$description: Added in 4.0. Previously hardcoded in the stylesheet renderer, so it was the one value no consumer could theme.

breakpoint.$description: Emitted for documentation and JS. Container queries use the literals; drift.test.ts keeps the two in step.

hairline.$description: Added in 4.0. The only sub-4px step, and the only one a component may use: it exists for a dot beside a label, nothing larger.

page.$description: Added in 4.0 for full-height empty states.

gutter.$description: Added in 4.0. The room a native select's dropdown arrow needs. Recurs in Select, Combobox and DatePicker for one reason, which is what makes it a role rather than three sites that happened to pick 32px.

hero.$description: Added in 4.0 for a full-height empty state's vertical breathing room. Narrowly justified: the other 48px in the codebase is a Switch track width, which is a control dimension and is in DS-GAPS.md rather than forced in here.

control.$description: Rounder in 4.3 (6px → 10px), to sit beside pill buttons and 20px surfaces without looking like a leftover.

surface.$description: Rounder in 4.2 (10px → 20px): with no border to draw it, the corner is what gives a surface its shape.

indicator.$description: Added in 4.0. The corner of a small drawn control - a checkbox box, a radio dot's ring. Was a 4px literal, which was never on the radius scale at all; radius.control (6px) reads as too round on a 16px box, and the 1px difference from 3px is not a design decision worth a new primitive.

overlay.$description: Added in 4.2. Menu, popover and listbox - smaller than a surface because they are smaller.

elevation.$description: Rewritten in 4.2. Five steps; every step above flat is three layered shadows; in the dark theme raised and floating add a top-edge highlight, and overlay and modal rely on material.rim for theirs. Pair a glass surface with material.rim: `box-shadow: var(--bh-material-rim), var(--bh-elevation-overlay)`.

raised.$description: Card, list container. The default for any surface since 4.2 - it replaces the border.

floating.$description: Added in 4.2. A hovered card, a toast.

control.$description: Added in 4.3. A filled or glass button - the lit edge says it can be pressed, the contact shadow that it sits on the page.

duration.$description: Added in 4.0. instant is a state flip the user should not perceive as motion; fast is the default for hover and focus; normal for anything that moves position or size; slow for a full-surface transition. spin and sweep are loop lengths, not transitions.

layer.$description: Added in 4.0. A z-index above 4 must name one of these.

hover.$description: A hovered or active row on a translucent surface. surface.sunken is opaque, and on glass it punches a solid hole in the material.

material.$description: Added in 4.2. Translucent surfaces for anything that floats over content. A material is bg + backdrop-filter: blur(var(--bh-material-*-blur)) saturate(var(--bh-material-saturation)), edged with material.rim instead of a border. Only for surfaces that sit over other content: on an empty page, glass is just grey.

blur.$description: A control laid over an image.
Dialog - the most text, so the most opaque.
App bar and sticky headers. Shows through only where content scrolls beneath.

rim.$description: The lit inner edge of glass. Goes first in the box-shadow list, before the elevation.

scrim.$description: Added in 4.2. The layer between a modal and the page. Lighter than the 55% it replaced, because the blur now does the separating.

com.bighat.contrast.$description: Every foreground/background relationship the system promises to keep legible. contrast.test.ts iterates this list and fails the build, so an undeclared pair is a review comment rather than a production bug. requirement maps to the WCAG rule that actually applies: a focus ring is non-text at 3:1, not 4.5:1.
